title: Physics feels like something only where it builds world models

statements.text: IIT and information closure theory tie consciousness to any instance of emergent causation. IWMT instead holds that consciousness may be what physics feels like from the inside if and only if physical processes support integrated system and world models with spatial, temporal and causal coherence.

sources.quote: if (and only if) physical processes support the generation of integrated system–world models with spatial, temporal, and causal coherence
